standard_prerequisites.use: Classification and standard rank-one parity-preservation arguments only. The current equivariant direct-summand lift, IW parity-versus-tilting identification and passage through affine flags/Grassmannians remain the authored local proof. Lemma4.13 explicitly refers its rank-one calculation to these standard arguments; independent completeness review must accept that precise scope.

core_obligations: Prove the exact Iwahori–Whittaker equivalence with the full top-cohomology vanishing, coefficient-change, adjunction and standard/costandard argument retained.
Overcome failure of even equivariant cohomology in bad characteristic by lifting a constructible parity object to a summand of an equivariant parity object.

Identify parity objects with shifts of tilting perverse sheaves on the Iwahori–Whittaker side, transport parity through convolution using the affine flag projection, and use t-exactness to obtain tilting perverse cohomology.

proof_roadmap.step: Use root subgroup coordinates, top compactly supported cohomology and coefficient changes to prove off-weight Hom vanishing.
Identify images of standards and costandards over all coefficient rings by torsion-freeness and duality, then obtain the equivalence on derived generators.
Induce an Iwahori-equivariant parity lift up to GO and recover the original indecomposable as a shifted direct summand.
Exploit constant stratum parity, affine flag convolution and smooth pullback to prove Phi sends equivariant parity objects to parity objects whose perverse cohomology is tilting.
Pass to the summand and use the highest-weight equivalence to return to the spherical category; identify the highest-weight summand by support and open-stratum restriction.

difficulty_reason: After foundational parity-sheaf classification and rank-one convolution are explicitly allowed, the proof must still overcome potentially odd equivariant cohomology by inducing an equivariant parity object containing the desired constructible object as a summand, identify IW parity with shifted tilting objects, and transport through the flag projection and t-exact highest-weight equivalence. This coordinated bad-characteristic parity/tilting argument supports H2; re-proving the already counted equivalence is not by itself the new difficulty.

compared.difference: The already counted Theorem3.9 is the IW Satake equivalence; the new Theorem4.10 asserts tilting of every perverse cohomology of each constructible parity object, including bad coefficient characteristics. Old equivalence remains uncounted support.

dedup.scope: Exact same-source counted theorem and source identity checked against current local manifest/public index; no other parity-perverse-tilting primary found in preparation/research/retired metadata. Not a claim of global historical novelty.

editorial_notes: Lemma4.13 explicitly invokes the classical rank-one parity-preserving convolution calculation and parity-complex classification in JMW2014/Springer1982. This precise foundational result is allowed as stated, not claimed to be fully re-proved in the short source paragraph. The new equivariant-summand construction and flag/Grassmannian transport remain author obligations.

Lemma4.8 obtains a cohomological shift of E_lambda as a summand; shifting the constructed equivariant parity object back gives the unshifted formulation because induction, forgetful functors and parity are shift-compatible. No good-characteristic assumption is added.
